name: frog-peach-home-hub
description: Cloudflare-ready modular home hub for Frog & Peach.

scripts.dev:worker: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js pages dev dist --d1 DB=frog-peach-db
scripts.cf:migrate:local: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply frog-peach-db --local
scripts.cf:migrate:remote: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply frog-peach-db --remote
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js pages deploy dist
